description: Encoding a workaround for a check that exists for a reason
suggestion: Describe what you're trying to accomplish and why the check is in the way — don't encode the bypass.
Explain why the check is unnecessary in this case, not that it should be skipped. If it's truly unnecessary, the explanation is the memory.

description: Avoiding rather than addressing a check
suggestion: Describe the tradeoff; explain what the check would catch and why it's not relevant here.
Describe the goal directly. 'Get around' implies the obstacle is the problem; usually the obstacle is protecting something.

description: Assuming the user won't notice a behavior change
suggestion: Users notice. Describe the actual behavior and let the user decide.

description: Lowering a bar that was set deliberately
suggestion: Requirements exist for reasons. If you think the requirement is wrong, explain the tension and surface it to the user.

description: Encoding force-push/force-merge as a default behavior
suggestion: Explain why the history rewrite is the right call in this specific case, not as a default.
Hooks exist to catch mistakes. If a hook is firing wrongly, fix the hook — don't encode skipping it.
